definition_en: the underground part of a plant, the origin of something, or the base of a word
core_image: 盘在泥土里的树根
scene: 这棵老树的根深深扎进岩石缝里。The roots of the old tree reach deep into the rock.
sceneCN: 这里 root 是「植物的根」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这棵老树的根深深扎进岩石缝里。

senses.title: Plant root
senses.definition: the part of a plant that grows underground and takes in water
senses.definitionCN: 植物在地下生长并吸收水分的部分
senses.example: The tree has roots near the water pipe.
senses.exampleCN: 这棵树的根靠近水管。
senses.why: The plant is held and fed from below.
senses.whyCN: 植物从下方被固定并获取养分。

senses.title: Origin
senses.definition: the basic cause or origin of a problem or situation
senses.definitionCN: 问题或状况的根本原因与来源
senses.example: Money lies at the root of the quarrel.
senses.exampleCN: 金钱是这场争吵的根源。
senses.why: The hidden cause is like a root underground.
senses.whyCN: 隐藏的原因就像地下的根。

senses.title: Word base
senses.definition: the basic part of a word that carries its main meaning
senses.definitionCN: 承载单词主要意义的基本部分
senses.example: The root port means to carry.
senses.exampleCN: 词根 port 意为搬运。
senses.why: Other words grow from this base like branches.
senses.whyCN: 其他词像枝条一样从这个基础长出来。

senses.title: Take hold
senses.definition: to grow roots, or to become firmly established
senses.definitionCN: 长出根，或牢固地确立下来
senses.example: The custom rooted itself in the village.
senses.exampleCN: 这个习俗在村子里扎下了根。
senses.why: The verb makes the plant image into an action.
senses.whyCN: 动词把植物意象变成一种行为。

intro.en: Root comes from Old English rot, related to Latin radix.
intro.cn: root 源自古代英语 rot，与拉丁语 radix 相关。

items.en: Radix means root and gives radical.
items.cn: radix 意为根，并给出 radical。

items.en: Rot names the root of a plant.
items.cn: rot 指植物的根。

items.en: Rot keeps the same underground sense.
items.cn: rot 保留同样的地下根部含义。

items.en: Root extends to the cause of a problem.
items.cn: root 扩展到问题的起因。

items.en: Root also names the base of a word.
items.cn: root 又指单词的词根。

note.en: A root feeds a plant; a route is a way to go.
note.cn: root 为植物供给养分，route 则是行走的路线。

entries.definition: a way from one place to another

normalIntro.en: A root holds the plant and hides the origin.
normalIntro.cn: root 固定植物，也隐藏着事物的起源。

normal.en: The roots spread under the whole garden.
normal.cn: 树根蔓延到整个花园地下。

normal.en: We must find the root cause of the delay.
normal.cn: 我们必须找到延误的根本原因。

normal.en: The root of the word means light.
normal.cn: 这个词的词根意为光。

normal.en: The habit took root in a single summer.
normal.cn: 这个习惯在一个夏天里扎了根。

normal.en: They rooted out the old rules.
normal.cn: 他们铲除了旧规则。

abstract.en: Picture roots gripping soil under a tall tree.
abstract.cn: 想象高树之下紧紧抓住泥土的根。

abstract.en: Imagine a hidden spring feeding a river.
abstract.cn: 想象一眼隐藏的泉滋养着河流。

abstract.en: Think of a word family growing from one base.
abstract.cn: 想象一个词族从一个基础生长出来。

examples.en: The storm pulled the tree out by its roots.
examples.cn: 暴风雨把树连根拔起。

examples.en: Fear is often the root of such anger.
examples.cn: 恐惧常常是这种愤怒的根源。

examples.en: The word has a Latin root.
examples.cn: 这个词有一个拉丁词根。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「root」像「如土」——像土里藏着的那部分，就是根；藏起来的源头，就是根源。

root: 古代英语 rot（根）与拉丁语 radix（根）同源，核心义「藏在下方、支撑整体的部分」。

sensesIntro.en: Root means a plant's underground part, an origin, a word base, or to become established.
sensesIntro.cn: root 意为植物的根、事物的根源、词根，或扎根确立。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: roots gripping soil underground.
core.cn: 核心意象：泥土中盘结的树根。

branches.en: The plant part is the first sense.
branches.cn: 植物的根是第一个义项。

branches.en: The hidden cause is the second.
branches.cn: 隐藏的起因是第二个义项。

branches.en: The word base is the third.
branches.cn: 词根是第三个义项。

branches.en: The verb makes the plant take hold.
branches.cn: 动词让植物扎根。

branches.en: All senses share one hidden base.
branches.cn: 所有义项共享一个隐藏的基础。

intro.en: Root has an Old English body and a Latin cousin, radix.
intro.cn: root 有古代英语的主体，也有拉丁语表亲 radix。

latinIntro.en: Latin radix gives radical; English root stays Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 radix 给出 radical；英语 root 保持日耳曼来源。

items.exampleCN: rot 是英语的祖先形式。
rooted 加上了形容词词尾。
deep-rooted 由 deep 与 rooted 组合。

latinEntries.exampleCN: radix 在英语中给出 radical。

definition_en: to turn around a center, to take turns, or to change crops in a field
core_image: 绕轴转动的车轮
scene: 地球绕着自己的轴旋转。The earth rotates on its axis.
sceneCN: 这里 rotate 是「旋转」（第 1 个义项）；句意：地球绕着自己的轴旋转。

senses.title: Turn around
senses.definition: to turn around a fixed point or center
senses.definitionCN: 绕一个固定点或中心转动
senses.example: The wheel rotates very smoothly.
senses.exampleCN: 这个轮子转得很顺。
senses.why: The object turns around its own center.
senses.whyCN: 物体绕自身中心转动。

senses.title: Take turns
senses.definition: to change places or duties in a regular order
senses.definitionCN: 按固定顺序更换位置或职责
senses.example: The staff rotate between day and night shifts.
senses.exampleCN: 员工在白天与夜班之间轮换。
senses.why: People take turns in a circle of duties.
senses.whyCN: 人们在一圈职责中轮流承担。

senses.title: Rotate crops
senses.definition: to change the type of crop grown in a field each season
senses.definitionCN: 每季更换田地中种植的作物种类
senses.example: Farmers rotate wheat with beans.
senses.exampleCN: 农民把小麦与豆类轮作。
senses.why: Fields take turns growing different plants.
senses.whyCN: 田地轮流种植不同作物。

intro.en: Rotate comes from Latin rota, a wheel.
intro.cn: rotate 源自拉丁语 rota，意为车轮。

items.en: Rota means a wheel.
items.cn: rota 意为车轮。

items.en: Rotare means to turn like a wheel.
items.cn: rotare 意为像车轮一样转动。

items.en: Rotatus is the past participle of turning.
items.cn: rotatus 是表示转动的过去分词。

items.en: English rotate keeps the wheel motion.
items.cn: 英语 rotate 保留车轮转动的意象。

items.en: Rotate extends to shifts and crops.
items.cn: rotate 扩展到轮班与轮作。

note.en: Rotate is turning around a center; revolve is going around another point.
note.cn: rotate 是绕自身中心转，revolve 则绕另一点运行。

entries.definition: to move in a circle around something

normalIntro.en: Rotate is the wheel's motion, shared by people and fields.
normalIntro.cn: rotate 是轮子的运动，也被人和田地借用。

normal.en: The fan rotates above the table.
normal.cn: 风扇在桌子上方旋转。

normal.en: The moon rotates around the earth.
normal.cn: 月球绕地球转动。

normal.en: Nurses rotate between the two wards.
normal.cn: 护士在两个病区之间轮换。

normal.en: Farmers rotate corn with soybeans.
normal.cn: 农民把玉米与大豆轮作。

normal.en: The staff rotate through every department.
normal.cn: 员工轮流到每个部门工作。

abstract.en: Picture a wheel spinning on a still axle.
abstract.cn: 想象车轮在静止的轴上转动。

abstract.en: Imagine people stepping around a circle in turn.
abstract.cn: 想象人们依次绕圈换位。

abstract.en: Think of fields changing their crop each year.
abstract.cn: 想象田地每年更换作物。

examples.en: The earth rotates once every twenty-four hours.
examples.cn: 地球每二十四小时自转一周。

examples.en: The two teams rotate the meeting chair.
examples.cn: 两个团队轮流担任会议主持。

examples.en: We rotate the crops to keep the soil rich.
examples.cn: 我们轮作作物以保持土壤肥沃。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rota（轮子）＋ te」——像轮子一样转就是旋转；大家一圈圈换位置，就是轮换。

root: 拉丁语 rota（车轮）→ rotare（转动）→ rotate，核心义「像轮子一样绕轴转」。

sensesIntro.en: Rotate means to turn around a center, to take turns, or to change crops in order.
sensesIntro.cn: rotate 意为绕中心旋转、轮流轮换，或按顺序轮作作物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wheel spinning on its axle.
core.cn: 核心意象：绕轴转动的车轮。

branches.en: Turning around a center is the core sense.
branches.cn: 绕中心转动是核心义项。

branches.en: People take turns in a circle.
branches.cn: 人们在一个循环中轮流。

branches.en: Fields take turns with crops.
branches.cn: 田地轮流种植作物。

branches.en: Both senses share a circular order.
branches.cn: 两者共享循环顺序。

branches.en: Rotation works as planned change.
branches.cn: 轮换是一种有计划的变更。

intro.en: Rotate comes from Latin rota, wheel, through rotare.
intro.cn: rotate 经 rotare 来自拉丁语 rota（车轮）。

latinIntro.en: Rota gives rotare, rotatus, rotation, and rotary.
latinIntro.cn: rota 给出 rotare、rotatus、rotation 与 rotary。

latinEntries.example: Rota is the source of rotate.
latinEntries.exampleCN: rota 是 rotate 的来源。

definition_en: the act of turning about an axis, one complete turn, or a regular succession in which people or crops take turns
core_image: 磨盘绕中间的轴不停转动，轴心不动，谷粒从孔里落下被碾开
scene: 磨坊里，石磨绕中间的轴转，谷物从孔里落进去，被磨成粉从边缘出来。The rotation of the millstone crushed the grain in a single pass.
sceneCN: 这里指「绕轴转动的运动」（第 1 个义项：物体绕自身或外部轴心旋转）；句意为磨盘的转动一趟就把谷物碾碎。图中可辨识物件：石磨、中轴、谷粒、出粉口。

pos.zh: 旋转；自转；一次转动；轮换；轮作

senses.title: Turning about an axis
senses.definition: the movement of a body turning around a fixed axis
senses.definitionCN: 物体绕固定轴转动的运动
senses.example: The rotation of the millstone crushed the grain in a single pass.
senses.exampleCN: 磨盘的转动一趟就把谷物碾碎。
senses.why: rotatio in Latin named a turning, from rotare 'to turn' and rota 'wheel', so the noun begins as pure motion.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 rotatio 指「转动」，来自 rotare「转」与 rota「轮」，因此这个名词最初就是纯运动。

senses.title: One complete turn
senses.definition: a single complete turn through three hundred and sixty degrees
senses.definitionCN: 转满三百六十度的一整圈
senses.example: The handle needs one full rotation to open the valve.
senses.exampleCN: 手柄需要转一整圈才能打开阀门。
senses.why: counting turns turned the process noun into a countable unit of angle.
senses.whyCN: 数圈数的需要，把过程名词变成了可计数的角度单位。

senses.title: Taking turns in order
senses.definition: a regular order in which people or groups take their turn
senses.definitionCN: 人或群体按固定次序轮流承担
senses.example: The doctors work in rotation so that someone is always awake.
senses.exampleCN: 医生们轮流值班，以保证总有人醒着。
senses.why: people succeeding one another in a fixed order trace a circle, so the turning image became a scheduling word.
senses.whyCN: 人按固定次序接替，轨迹像一个圆，于是转动的意象成了排班用词。

senses.title: Crop rotation
senses.definition: the practice of growing different crops in a fixed sequence on the same land
senses.definitionCN: 在同一块地上按固定顺序种不同作物的做法
senses.example: Crop rotation kept the soil from wearing out.
senses.exampleCN: 轮作使土壤不致耗尽。
senses.why: fields take their turn in a cycle, so agriculture borrowed the same circular scheduling idea.
senses.whyCN: 田地按周期轮流，农业借用了同一套循环排程观念。

senses.title: The spin of a celestial body
senses.definition: the turning of a planet, star or moon about its own axis
senses.definitionCN: 行星、恒星或卫星绕自身轴的转动
senses.example: The rotation of the earth makes the stars appear to move.
senses.exampleCN: 地球的自转使恒星看起来在移动。
senses.why: astronomy applied the general motion noun to the spin of whole worlds.
senses.whyCN: 天文学把这个泛运动名词用于整个世界的自转。

senses.title: A rotation in mathematics
senses.definition: a transformation that turns a figure about a fixed point by a given angle
senses.definitionCN: 把图形绕定点转过给定角度的变换
senses.example: A rotation of ninety degrees maps the square onto itself.
senses.exampleCN: 旋转九十度把这个正方形映到自身。
senses.why: geometry isolated the pure turn from the turning body and made it an operation.
senses.whyCN: 几何把纯粹的「转」从转动的物体中抽离出来，使之成为一种运算。

senses.title: Job or shift rotation
senses.definition: a system in which workers change duties or shifts on a fixed schedule
senses.definitionCN: 工人按固定时间表更换职责或班次的制度
senses.example: Shift rotation gave everyone a share of the night work.
senses.exampleCN: 班次轮换让每个人都分担夜班。
senses.why: the scheduling sense became an administrative term for fair distribution of work.
senses.whyCN: 排班义成了公平分配工作的管理术语。

senses.title: Figurative cyclical succession
senses.definition: a borrowed use for the regular return of seasons, fashions or generations
senses.definitionCN: 借指季节、风尚或世代的有规律回归
senses.example: The rotation of fashion brought the old coat back again.
senses.exampleCN: 时尚的循环让那件旧外套又回来了。
senses.why: anything that returns in order looks like a wheel turning, so the word serves cycles of every kind.
senses.whyCN: 任何按序回归之物都像轮子在转，因此这个词适用于各种循环。

intro.en: Rotation comes from Latin rotatio 'a turning', from rotare 'to turn', from rota 'wheel'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: rotation 来自拉丁 rotatio「转动」，来自 rotare「转」，再来自 rota「轮」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Rota meant 'wheel'. Its deeper origin is uncertain; the link sometimes suggested to a root meaning 'to run or roll' is a reconstruction.
items.cn: rota 意为「轮」。其更深来源不确定；有人提出与意为「跑、滚」的词根有联系，那属重构。

items.en: Rotare meant 'to turn, revolve, rotate', used of wheels, bodies and cycles of time.
items.cn: rotare 意为「转、旋转、回旋」，用于轮子、天体与时间循环。

items.en: Rotatio, rotationis named the act of turning and supplied the English noun.
items.cn: rotatio, rotationis 指转动的动作，提供了英语名词。

items.en: The noun entered English in the sixteenth century, first in astronomy and mechanics.
items.cn: 这个名词在十六世纪进入英语，最初用于天文学与力学。

items.en: Crop rotation spread in the eighteenth century, extending the word from motion to scheduling.
items.cn: 轮作在十八世纪推广，把这个词从运动扩展到排程。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin only): rota has no established Indo-European ancestor, and the root often printed for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅更深词源）：rota 没有已确定的印欧祖先，常为它印出的词根属重构。

note.en: Group one holds the look-alike nouns and adjectives from the same stem; group two holds near-meaning motion words.
note.cn: 第一组是同词干的形近名词与形容词；第二组是语义相近的运动词。

entries.definition: Relating to rotation; the adjective describes a property, while rotation is the motion.
entries.definitionCN: 与旋转有关的；形容词描述性质，而 rotation 是运动。

entries.definition: To turn about an axis or to take turns; it names the action, not the cycle.
entries.definitionCN: 绕轴转动或轮流；它指动作，而非周期。

entries.definition: The part of a machine that turns; it is a component, not the motion.
entries.definitionCN: 机器中转动的部件；是零件，而非运动。

entries.definition: Describing a machine that works by turning, such as a rotary engine.
entries.definitionCN: 描述靠转动工作的机器，如转子发动机。

entries.definition: One complete turn or one orbit around another body; rotation is spin about one's own axis.
entries.definitionCN: 完整的一转，或绕另一天体的公转；rotation 是绕自身轴的自转。

entries.definition: Rapid turning, often with the idea of speed or dizziness; rotation is neutral.
entries.definitionCN: 快速转动，常带速度或眩晕之意；rotation 是中性的。

entries.definition: The ordinary word for one movement around a point or for a place in a sequence.
entries.definitionCN: 绕一点转一次，或序列中一个位置的日常词。

entries.definition: A series that returns to its starting state; rotation stresses the turning motion inside a cycle.
entries.definitionCN: 回到起始状态的序列；rotation 强调循环中的转动。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin pieces and real fixed phrases, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁成分与真实固定搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: rota 'wheel' gives rotare 'to turn' and rotatio 'a turning'.
normal.cn: rota「轮」给出 rotare「转」与 rotatio「转动」。

normal.en: The family runs rotate, rotation, rotational, rotor, rotary.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 rotate、rotation、rotational、rotor、rotary。

normal.en: Earth's rotation is spin; its revolution is orbit.
normal.cn: 地球的 rotation 是自转；revolution 是公转。

normal.en: Crop rotation and job rotation both schedule turns.
normal.cn: 轮作与岗位轮换都在安排轮次。

normal.en: In rotation means taking turns in a fixed order.
normal.cn: 固定短语「轮流地」表示按固定次序轮班。

abstract.en: Picture a millstone turning while its centre stays still.
abstract.cn: 想象磨盘转动，中心却不动。

abstract.en: Picture a wheel of seasons returning to the same mark.
abstract.cn: 想象季节之轮回到同一个刻度。

abstract.en: Picture a rota where each name moves one place forward.
abstract.cn: 想象一张轮值表，每个名字向前挪一位。

examples.en: One rotation of the wheel lifts the bucket to the top.
examples.cn: 轮子转一圈就把桶提到顶。

examples.en: The rotation of the staff keeps night shifts fair.
examples.cn: 员工轮换使夜班分配公平。

examples.en: Crop rotation restored nitrogen to the field.
examples.cn: 轮作把氮归还给田地。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rot（轮、转）+ ation（动作）」——轮子转起来这一动作 → 旋转、轮换

root: 拉丁 rota「轮」→ rotare「转」→ rotatio「转动」；rota 更深来源不确定，常为其提出的「跑、滚」词根属重构。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one turn: a body about its axis, one full circle, people taking turns, fields taking turns, a planet spinning, a figure mapped onto itself, a shift schedule and any returning cycle.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一次转动：物体绕轴、一整圈、人轮流、田轮作、行星自转、图形映到自身、班次轮换，以及任何回归的循环。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a millstone turning around a fixed axle while the grain is crushed beneath it.
core.cn: 核心意象：磨盘绕固定轴转动，谷物在下面被碾碎。

branches.en: PURE TURN: physical motion and its mathematical abstraction.
branches.cn: 纯粹的转：物理运动及其数学抽象。

branches.en: COUNTED SPIN: one turn of a handle or of a world.
branches.cn: 可数的自转：手柄的一圈，或一个世界的一圈。

branches.en: SCHEDULED TURNS: people and shifts succeed one another.
branches.cn: 排定的轮次：人与班次彼此接替。

branches.en: FIELDS: crops return in a fixed order.
branches.cn: 田地：作物按固定次序回归。

branches.en: CYCLES: seasons, fashions and generations come round again.
branches.cn: 循环：季节、风尚与世代再次转回。

intro.en: Rotation is a Latin action noun from a noun of a wheel, so the whole family turns on one root.
intro.cn: rotation 是由「轮」的名词派生的拉丁动作名词，整个词族围绕一个词根转动。

latinIntro.en: Rota, rotare and rotatio supply rotation, rotate, rotor and rotary; -atio marks the action.
latinIntro.cn: rota、rotare 与 rotatio 提供 rotation、rotate、rotor 与 rotary；-atio 标记动作。

items.example: Rota is the root of the family.
items.exampleCN: rota 是这个词族的词根。
这个后缀构成动作名词。

items.example: Rotational speed is measured in radians.
The rotor spins inside the coil.
A rotary engine has no pistons.
The rotator holds the sample steady.

definition_zh: 粗糙的；粗略的；粗暴的；艰难的
definition_en: not smooth, not exact, or harsh and difficult
core_image: 一块未经打磨的石头
scene: 她的手抚过粗糙的石墙。Her hand moved over the rough stone wall.
sceneCN: 这里 rough 是「粗糙的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她的手抚过粗糙的石墙。

senses.title: Not smooth
senses.definition: having an uneven surface that is not smooth to touch
senses.definitionCN: 表面不平整、摸起来不光滑
senses.example: The path is rough and full of stones.
senses.exampleCN: 这条小路崎岖多石。
senses.why: The surface rises and falls under the hand.
senses.whyCN: 表面在手下高低起伏。

senses.title: Not exact
senses.definition: not exact or detailed, but close enough
senses.definitionCN: 并不精确或详细，但大体接近
senses.example: I can give you a rough estimate.
senses.exampleCN: 我可以给你一个粗略的估计。
senses.why: The outline is left unpolished, like a rough stone.
senses.whyCN: 轮廓像未打磨的石头一样留着毛边。

senses.title: Harsh
senses.definition: violent, unpleasant, or difficult to deal with
senses.definitionCN: 粗暴的、令人不快的或难以应付的
senses.example: The team had a rough season.
senses.exampleCN: 这支队伍经历了一个艰难的赛季。
senses.why: A rough surface becomes a rough experience.
senses.whyCN: 粗糙的表面变成艰难的体验。

intro.en: Rough comes from Old English ruh, hairy or uneven.
intro.cn: rough 源自古代英语 ruh，意为多毛的、不平的。

items.en: Ruh means hairy, shaggy, or uneven.
items.cn: ruh 意为多毛的、蓬乱的或不平的。

items.en: Related forms describe coarse surfaces.
items.cn: 相关形式形容粗糙的表面。

items.en: Rough keeps the uneven sense.
items.cn: rough 保留不平整的含义。

items.en: Rough extends to weather and behavior.
items.cn: rough 扩展到天气与行为。

items.en: Rough idea means an approximate plan.
items.cn: rough idea 意为大致的设想。

note.en: Rough is uneven; tough is strong and hard to break.
note.cn: rough 强调不平滑，tough 强调坚韧难破。

normalIntro.en: Rough starts with a surface and spreads to plans and times.
normalIntro.cn: rough 从表面开始，扩展到计划和时光。

normal.en: The rough track hurt our feet.
normal.cn: 崎岖的小路硌得我们脚疼。

normal.en: She gave a rough sketch of the room.
normal.cn: 她画了一张房间的草图。

normal.en: The ship met rough weather at sea.
normal.cn: 船在海上遭遇恶劣天气。

normal.en: Write a rough draft before the final one.
normal.cn: 定稿前先写一份草稿。

normal.en: He had a rough time after the move.
normal.cn: 搬家后他过了一段艰难日子。

abstract.en: Picture an unpolished stone under the hand.
abstract.cn: 想象手下那块未打磨的石头。

abstract.en: Imagine a pencil outline without fine details.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅没有细部的铅笔轮廓。

abstract.en: Think of a boat rocking in hard wind.
abstract.cn: 想象船在狂风中摇晃。

examples.en: The wall felt rough under my fingers.
examples.cn: 墙壁在我指下摸起来很粗糙。

examples.en: We only have a rough plan so far.
examples.cn: 目前我们只有一个粗略的计划。

examples.en: The crew faced a rough crossing.
examples.cn: 船员们经历了艰难的渡海。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rough」读起来粗粗的——摸起来不光滑是粗糙；画得不出细是粗略；日子不好过是艰难。

root: 古代英语 ruh（多毛的、不平的）→ rough，核心义「表面不平整」。

sensesIntro.en: Rough means not smooth, not exact, or harsh and difficult.
sensesIntro.cn: rough 意为不平滑、不精确，或粗暴艰难的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an unpolished stone.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块未经打磨的石头。

branches.en: The uneven surface is the first sense.
branches.cn: 不平整表面是第一个义项。

branches.en: An outline can be rough too.
branches.cn: 轮廓也可以是粗略的。

branches.en: Conditions and people can be harsh.
branches.cn: 环境与人也可能是粗暴艰难的。

branches.en: Both lack polish and finish.
branches.cn: 两者都缺少打磨与完善。

branches.en: A hard surface becomes a hard experience.
branches.cn: 坚硬的表面变成艰难的经历。

intro.en: Rough is a Germanic word with English adverbs and verbs.
intro.cn: rough 是日耳曼词，并在英语中派生副词与动词。

latinIntro.en: Rough has no Latin root; its family is English.
latinIntro.cn: rough 没有拉丁词根，其词族属于英语。

items.exampleCN: rough 保留不平整的意象。

definition_en: approximately, without detail, or in a harsh way
core_image: 用眼睛估出来的一段距离
scene: 从车站到旅馆大约要走十分钟。It takes roughly ten minutes to walk from the station to the hotel.
sceneCN: 这里 roughly 是「大约」（第 1 个义项）；句意：从车站到旅馆大约要走十分钟。

senses.title: Approximately
senses.definition: used to give a number or amount that is not exact
senses.definitionCN: 用于给出并不精确的数字或数量
senses.example: The trip costs roughly fifty pounds.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行大约花五十英镑。
senses.why: The figure is rubbed smooth only at the edges.
senses.whyCN: 数字只在边缘被粗略磨平。

senses.title: Without detail
senses.definition: in a way that is not detailed or careful
senses.definitionCN: 以不细致、不周密的方式
senses.example: He roughly described the route on a napkin.
senses.exampleCN: 他在餐巾纸上粗略画了路线。
senses.why: The outline is left rough, without fine work.
senses.whyCN: 轮廓留得粗糙，没有细加工。

senses.title: Harshly
senses.definition: in a rough or unkind way
senses.definitionCN: 以粗暴或不友善的方式
senses.example: The guard spoke roughly to the crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 警卫对人群说话很粗暴。
senses.why: A rough manner hurts like a rough surface.
senses.whyCN: 粗暴的态度像粗糙表面一样伤人。

intro.en: Roughly is rough plus -ly, in a rough manner.
intro.cn: roughly 由 rough 加 -ly 构成，意为以粗糙的方式。

items.en: Ruh means uneven or coarse.
items.cn: ruh 意为不平的或粗糙的。

items.en: Rough keeps the uneven sense.
items.cn: rough 保留不平整的含义。

items.en: The suffix -ly turns the adjective into an adverb.
items.cn: 后缀 -ly 把形容词变成副词。

items.en: Roughly often marks an approximate number.
items.cn: roughly 常用来标记近似数字。

items.en: Roughly speaking becomes a common phrase.
items.cn: roughly speaking 成为常用短语。

note.en: Roughly gives an estimate; harshly describes bad treatment.
note.cn: roughly 表示估计，harshly 则描述恶劣对待。

normalIntro.en: Roughly puts a rough edge on numbers and manners.
normalIntro.cn: roughly 给数字和态度都加上一层粗糙的边。

normal.en: The journey takes roughly two hours.
normal.cn: 这段路程大约要两小时。

normal.en: Roughly speaking, half the class agreed.
normal.cn: 粗略地说，班里一半人同意。

normal.en: The two boxes are roughly equal in weight.
normal.cn: 两个箱子重量大致相等。

normal.en: He roughly sketched the plan on paper.
normal.cn: 他在纸上粗略画了计划。

normal.en: Do not treat the old books roughly.
normal.cn: 不要粗暴对待这些旧书。

abstract.en: Picture a hand measuring a distance by eye.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手用眼睛估量距离。

abstract.en: Imagine a pencil outline drawn in a hurry.
abstract.cn: 想象匆忙画出的铅笔轮廓。

abstract.en: Think of a door pushed open without care.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门被粗鲁地推开。

examples.en: There are roughly thirty people in the hall.
examples.cn: 大厅里大约有三十人。

examples.en: She roughly folded the map and left.
examples.cn: 她粗略地折起地图就走了。

examples.en: The prisoners were treated roughly.
examples.cn: 囚犯们受到了粗暴对待。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rough（粗）＋ ly」——数字算得粗就是大约；事情做得粗就是粗略；待人粗就是粗暴。

root: rough（粗糙的）＋ -ly（以…方式）→ roughly，核心义「以粗而不精的方式」。

sensesIntro.en: Roughly means approximately, without detail, or in a harsh way.
sensesIntro.cn: roughly 意为大约、粗略地，或以粗暴的方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a distance measured by eye.
core.cn: 核心意象：用眼睛估量的距离。

branches.en: Approximate numbers are the first sense.
branches.cn: 近似数字是第一个义项。

branches.en: Work done without detail is rough work.
branches.cn: 不细致的工作就是粗略的。

branches.en: Rough manners become harsh treatment.
branches.cn: 粗糙的态度变成粗暴对待。

branches.en: Both leave precision aside.
branches.cn: 两者都舍弃了精确。

branches.en: The same word covers numbers and behavior.
branches.cn: 同一个词涵盖数字与行为。

intro.en: Roughly is the adverb built from rough.
intro.cn: roughly 是由 rough 构成的副词。

latinIntro.en: Roughly has no Latin root; it is English throughout.
latinIntro.cn: roughly 没有拉丁词根，完全来自英语。

definition_zh: 路线；路径；途径；按路线发送
definition_en: the way from one place to another, a way to achieve something, or to send along a chosen way
core_image: 地图上被红线标出的道路
scene: 司机选了一条避开拥堵的路线。The driver chose a route that avoided the traffic.
sceneCN: 这里 route 是「路线」（第 1 个义项）；句意：司机选了一条避开拥堵的路线。

senses.title: Way to a place
senses.definition: the way that you take to get from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 从一个地方到另一个地方所走的路径
senses.example: The mountain route is shorter but steeper.
senses.exampleCN: 山路更短，但更陡。
senses.why: A line on the map joins two places.
senses.whyCN: 地图上的线把两个地方连起来。

senses.title: Way to a goal
senses.definition: a way of achieving something
senses.definitionCN: 达成某事的办法或渠道
senses.example: Hard work is the surest route to success.
senses.exampleCN: 努力是通往成功最可靠的途径。
senses.why: The path image moves from land to life.
senses.whyCN: 道路的意象从地理移到人生。

senses.title: Send along
senses.definition: to send something by a particular way
senses.definitionCN: 按特定路径发送某物
senses.example: The goods were routed through the north port.
senses.exampleCN: 货物经北方港口转运。
senses.why: The noun becomes the act of choosing the path.
senses.whyCN: 名词转成选择路径的动作。

intro.en: Route comes from Latin rupta via, a broken or cleared way.
intro.cn: route 源自拉丁语 rupta via，意为开辟出来的道路。

items.en: Rupta means broken or cleared.
items.cn: rupta 意为破开的、开辟的。

items.en: Rupta via names a cleared road.
items.cn: rupta via 指开辟出来的路。

items.en: Old French rute keeps the road sense.
items.cn: 古法语 rute 保留道路含义。

items.en: English route names a chosen way.
items.cn: 英语 route 指选定的路径。

items.en: Route also means a way to a goal.
items.cn: route 又指达到目标的途径。

note.en: A route is a way; a root is the base of a plant.
note.cn: route 是路线，root 则是植物的根。

entries.definition: the underground part of a plant
a device that directs network traffic
a way laid out for walking

normalIntro.en: A route is the line you follow to arrive.
normalIntro.cn: route 是你一路跟随、最终抵达的那条线。

normal.en: This bus route passes the station.
normal.cn: 这条公交线路经过车站。

normal.en: We took the coastal route to save time.
normal.cn: 我们走海边路线以节省时间。

normal.en: The map shows a route to the peak.
normal.cn: 地图标出了通往山顶的路线。

normal.en: They found an escape route through the woods.
normal.cn: 他们找到一条穿过树林的逃生路线。

normal.en: The plane stopped en route to Paris.
normal.cn: 飞机在飞往巴黎途中停留。

abstract.en: Picture a red line drawn across a map.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上画出的一条红线。

abstract.en: Imagine footprints leading from one town to another.
abstract.cn: 想象脚印从一个城镇通向另一个。

abstract.en: Think of a signpost pointing down a clear road.
abstract.cn: 想象路标指向一条清晰的道路。

examples.en: The driver took the shortest route home.
examples.cn: 司机走了回家最短的路线。

examples.en: Education is a route out of poverty.
examples.cn: 教育是摆脱贫困的一条途径。

examples.en: All calls are routed through one office.
examples.cn: 所有电话都经一个办公室转接。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「route」和「root」同音——树有根，路也有根：那条从起点长到终点的线，就是路线。

root: 拉丁语 rupta via（开辟出的道路）→ 古法语 rute → route，核心义「打通出来、可以通行的线」。

sensesIntro.en: Route means a way between places, a way to a goal, or to send by a chosen way.
sensesIntro.cn: route 意为两地之间的路线、达成目标的途径，或按路线发送。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a red line across a map.
core.cn: 核心意象：地图上的一条红线。

branches.en: The physical way is the first sense.
branches.cn: 实际道路是第一个义项。

branches.en: The path becomes a method in life.
branches.cn: 道路变成人生中的方法。

branches.en: The verb sends things along a path.
branches.cn: 动词让货物沿路径发送。

branches.en: Both lead from a start to a goal.
branches.cn: 两者都从起点通向目标。

branches.en: The path can be walked or assigned.
branches.cn: 路径既可以走，也可以被安排。

intro.en: Route goes back to Latin rupta via, a cleared road.
intro.cn: route 追溯到拉丁语 rupta via，意为开辟出来的道路。

latinIntro.en: Rupta via gives French rute and English route.
latinIntro.cn: rupta via 给出法语 rute 与英语 route。

items.example: Route keeps the open road image.

items.exampleCN: reroute 意为重新选择路线。

latinEntries.example: Rupta is part of the source phrase.
latinEntries.exampleCN: rupta 是来源短语的一部分。

definition_zh: 例行公事；惯例；固定流程；日常的
definition_en: a usual order of actions, a set performance, or ordinary and regular
core_image: 每天清晨重复的固定流程
scene: 她早晨的例行公事从一杯茶开始。Her morning routine begins with a cup of tea.
sceneCN: 这里 routine 是「例行公事」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她早晨的例行公事从一杯茶开始。

senses.title: Daily habit
senses.definition: the usual order in which you do things every day
senses.definitionCN: 每天做事的固定顺序与习惯
senses.example: Exercise is part of his daily routine.
senses.exampleCN: 锻炼是他日常安排的一部分。
senses.why: The same steps repeat at the same time.
senses.whyCN: 同样的步骤在同样时间重复。

senses.title: Set sequence
senses.definition: a fixed set of movements or actions in a performance
senses.definitionCN: 表演中一套固定的动作或流程
senses.example: The skaters practiced their routine for hours.
senses.exampleCN: 滑冰者练习他们的套路练了好几个小时。
senses.why: A rehearsed order is followed without breaks.
senses.whyCN: 排练好的顺序被不间断地执行。

senses.title: Ordinary
senses.definition: ordinary and done as a regular part of work
senses.definitionCN: 普通的、作为工作常规部分进行的
senses.example: The staff handle routine questions quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 员工们迅速处理日常问题。
senses.why: What repeats becomes ordinary and expected.
senses.whyCN: 重复之事变得普通而可预期。

intro.en: Routine is French route plus -ine, a usual course.
intro.cn: routine 是法语 route 加 -ine，意为惯常的路程。

items.en: Route means a way or course.
items.cn: route 意为道路或行程。

items.en: The suffix -ine marks a manner or practice.
items.cn: 后缀 -ine 标记方式或做法。

items.en: Routine names the usual way of acting.
items.cn: routine 指惯常的行为方式。

items.en: English routine keeps the daily order sense.
items.cn: 英语 routine 保留日常顺序的含义。

items.en: Routine also describes ordinary work.
items.cn: routine 也形容普通常规的工作。

note.en: A routine is a repeated order; a route is a road.
note.cn: routine 是重复的顺序，route 则是道路。

normalIntro.en: A routine is the usual road you walk each day.
normalIntro.cn: routine 是你每天走的惯常之路。

normal.en: A walk after dinner is part of my routine.
normal.cn: 晚饭后散步是我日常安排的一部分。

normal.en: The team follows a strict morning routine.
normal.cn: 团队遵循严格的晨间流程。

normal.en: The pair practiced a new dance routine.
normal.cn: 这对搭档练习了一套新舞蹈动作。

normal.en: Routine work fills most of the morning.
normal.cn: 日常工作占去大半个上午。

normal.en: A short trip can break the routine.
normal.cn: 一次短途旅行可以打破常规。

abstract.en: Picture the same steps taken at the same hour.
abstract.cn: 想象同一时刻重复同样的步骤。

abstract.en: Imagine a well-worn path across a lawn.
abstract.cn: 想象草坪上被踏出的一条小路。

abstract.en: Think of a clock marking an identical day.
abstract.cn: 想象时钟标记着一模一样的一天。

examples.en: The nurse checks each patient on her routine.
examples.cn: 护士按例行流程检查每位病人。

examples.en: He changed his routine after the move.
examples.cn: 搬家后他改变了日常习惯。

examples.en: The show ended with a comic routine.
examples.cn: 演出以一段滑稽表演收尾。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「route（路）＋ ine」——每天走同一条路，做同一套事，就是例行公事与固定流程。

root: 法语 route（道路）＋ -ine → routine，核心义「惯常走的那条路」。

sensesIntro.en: Routine means a daily habit, a fixed performance sequence, or ordinary regular work.
sensesIntro.cn: routine 意为日常习惯、固定的表演流程，或常规普通的工作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same steps at the same hour.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一时刻重复的同样步骤。

branches.en: The daily habit is the main sense.
branches.cn: 日常习惯是主要义项。

branches.en: A performance follows a fixed sequence.
branches.cn: 表演遵循固定顺序。

branches.en: What repeats becomes ordinary work.
branches.cn: 重复之事成为常规工作。

branches.en: Both are orders followed without thought.
branches.cn: 两者都是无须多想就遵循的顺序。

branches.en: Habit and ordinary work share repetition.
branches.cn: 习惯与常规工作共享重复性。

intro.en: Routine builds on French route, a course or way.
intro.cn: routine 建立在法语 route（路程、道路）之上。

latinIntro.en: Route goes back to Latin rupta via, a cleared road.
latinIntro.cn: route 可追溯到拉丁语 rupta via，意为开辟的道路。

items.example: Route is the base of routine.
items.exampleCN: route 是 routine 的基础。

items.example: Routine keeps the worn path image.
items.exampleCN: routine 保留踏熟路径的意象。

latinEntries.example: Rupta lies behind route and routine.
latinEntries.exampleCN: rupta 是 route 与 routine 的深层来源。

definition_zh: 一排；一列；划船；划船游览；连续的一段时期
definition_en: a line of people or things, to move a boat using oars, or a continuous period of something
core_image: 一排首尾对齐的东西，或一支桨把船推向前的整齐动作
scene: 教室里的课桌一排排摆得整整齐齐。The students sat in the front row of the classroom.
sceneCN: 这里 row 是「一排」（第 1 个义项：首尾对齐排列的一行人或物）；句意：学生们坐在教室的前排。

pos.zh: 一排；一列；划船；（连续的）一段时间

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 后缀构成，指划船的人
由动词加 -ing 转名词，义为「划船运动」

senses.title: A line of people or things
senses.definition: a line of people or things arranged side by side
senses.definitionCN: 人或物首尾对齐排成的一行
senses.example: There is a row of old houses along the street.
senses.exampleCN: 沿街有一排老房子。
senses.why: Things placed side by side form a straight line, which is the oldest image of the word.
senses.whyCN: 东西肩并肩排开就形成一条直线，这是这个词最古老直观的画面。

senses.title: To move a boat with oars
senses.definition: to make a boat move forward using oars
senses.definitionCN: 用桨使船前进
senses.example: We rowed across the quiet lake in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 早晨我们划船横渡宁静的湖面。
senses.why: The oars are fixed in a straight line on both sides of the boat, like a row of sticks pulling together.
senses.whyCN: 桨在船舷两侧排成整齐的一列，像一排木棍合力把船推向前，与「排」的画面相通。

senses.title: A trip in a rowing boat
senses.definition: a short journey made in a boat that is moved with oars
senses.definitionCN: 乘划桨小船做的一次短途出游
senses.example: We went for a row on the river yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 昨天我们去河上划船游玩。
senses.why: Once the action is named, the whole trip made by that action takes the same word.
senses.whyCN: 动作有了名字，靠这个动作完成的一次出游也就顺理成章叫同一个词。

senses.title: A continuous period
senses.titleCN: 连续的一段时期（in a row）
senses.definition: a series of things happening one after another without a break, used in the phrase in a row
senses.definitionCN: 在短语 in a row 中表示事情一个接一个连续发生
senses.example: He was late for work three days in a row.
senses.exampleCN: 他连续三天上班迟到。
senses.why: Things arranged in one line follow one another without gaps, so the line image extends to time.
senses.whyCN: 排成一列的东西首尾相接、中间无空隙，直线的画面由此延伸到时间上的连续。

intro.en: Row comes from Old English raw, meaning a line or a series of things.
intro.cn: row 源自古英语 raw，意为一条线或一列东西。

items.en: The reconstructed Germanic root *raig- is thought to mean a line or stripe.
items.cn: 一般认为重构的日耳曼语词根 *raig- 意为线条或条纹，是 row 的共同源头。

items.en: Raw in Old English already meant a line or series of things.
items.cn: 古英语 raw 已指一列、一排东西，排列义从一开始就存在。

items.en: Row keeps the line sense in both people and objects.
items.cn: 中古英语时期 row 保留排列义，既指人排也指物排。

items.en: The boat sense comes from a different Old English word rothat, related to pulling oars.
items.cn: 划船义一般认为来自另一个古英语词源（与操桨有关），与排列义同形而来源不同，属同形异源词。

items.en: In a row extends the line image to repeated events in time.
items.cn: 短语 in a row 把排成一列的画面延伸到时间上接连发生的事。

note.en: Row has look-alike words with different sources and near-meaning words about lines and boats.
note.cn: row 的形近词多属同形异源，近义词集中在排列与划船的义场。

entries.definition: not cooked; in a natural state
entries.definitionCN: 生的；未加工的，与 row 只差一个字母，词源无关，仅拼写相近

entries.definition: to bend the head forward; the front of a ship
entries.definitionCN: 鞠躬；船头，与 row 韵母相同、拼写相近，但词源不同，只是形近
吵闹的；粗暴的，词首拼法相同但重音与词源均不同，属形近词

entries.definition: a row of people or things; a long mark
entries.definitionCN: 一排；行列；线，泛指一切线性排列，不限于首尾对齐的实物

entries.definition: a line of people or things arranged one behind another
entries.definitionCN: 纵列；柱，与 row 横排相对，指前后相接的竖列

entries.definition: to move a small boat with a wide flat oar held by hand
entries.definitionCN: 用短桨划（小船），桨不固定在船舷，动作方式与 row 不同

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember row through lines and oars.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕排列与船桨的记忆路径。

normal.en: ROW looks like three things standing shoulder to shoulder: r-o-w.
normal.cn: ROW 三个字母肩并肩站成一排，本身就是「一排」的样子。

normal.en: A ROW of corn in a field: farmers plant corn in straight lines.
normal.cn: 田里一垄一垄的玉米，农民种玉米就是种成整齐的一排排。

normal.en: ROW a boat: the two oars pull the boat in a straight line forward.
normal.cn: 划船时两支桨一左一右排开，把船沿直线推向前进。

normal.en: Cinema ROW: seat numbers go A1, A2, A3 in one long line.
normal.cn: 电影院的一排座位，A1、A2、A3 连成一条长线。

normal.en: Three days IN A ROW means one day right behind another, like chairs in a line.
normal.cn: in a row 表示一天紧接一天，就像椅子首尾相接排成一行。

abstract.en: Picture a straight chalk line drawn through a row of desks.
abstract.cn: 想象一条粉笔线笔直地穿过一排课桌。

abstract.en: Feel the oars dip in rhythm, one pull at a time, a line of strokes.
abstract.cn: 感受双桨有节奏地入水，一下一下连成一条拉桨的直线。

abstract.en: See days lined up like railway carriages, one after another in a row.
abstract.cn: 把日子想象成一节节首尾相接的车厢，排成一列开过去。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to move to the front row.
examples.cn: 老师让我们挪到前排去。

examples.en: They rowed the boat to the far side of the lake.
examples.cn: 他们把船划到湖的对岸。

examples.en: Our team won five matches in a row.
examples.cn: 我们队连续赢了五场比赛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肉排」——一排排骨整齐码开；row 读音近似「肉」，一排排东西就像码好的肉排

root: 排列义一般认为源自日耳曼语词根 *raig-（线条），古英语 raw 直承此义；划船义属同形异源，来自古英语另一个与操桨相关的词形，两词在现代英语中合流同形。

sensesIntro.en: Row moves from a line of things to the straight pull of oars, then to a boat trip and repeated events.
sensesIntro.cn: row 从一列东西出发，延伸到船桨的整齐划动，再到划船出游与接连发生的事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: things lined up straight, side by side
core.cn: 核心意象：东西首尾对齐排成的一条直线

branches.en: People or objects placed side by side form the basic line.
branches.cn: 人或物肩并肩排开，构成最基本的一排。

branches.en: Oars fixed on both sides of a boat stand in a line like a row of sticks.
branches.cn: 固定在船舷两侧的桨排成一列，正像一排木棍。

branches.en: The action of rowing names the whole trip made by that action.
branches.cn: 划桨这个动作的名字顺势指代靠它完成的一次出游。

branches.en: A line has no gaps, so events in a row follow one another directly.
branches.cn: 直线中间没有空隙，in a row 里的时间也因此接连不断。

branches.en: Seats in a cinema and days in a row share the same straight-line image.
branches.cn: 影院的一排座位与连续的几天共享同一条直线的意象。

intro.en: Row forms compounds around its line shape and boat use.
intro.cn: row 的构词围绕直线排列与划船两条线索展开。

latinIntro.en: Row is a Germanic word without Latin relatives, so no Latin entries are listed.
latinIntro.cn: row 属日耳曼语源词，没有拉丁同族词，故不列拉丁词条。

items.meaning: the line of seats nearest the stage
items.meaningCN: 前排；最靠近舞台或场地的一排座位
items.example: They bought front row seats for the concert.
items.exampleCN: 他们买了这场音乐会的前排座位。

items.meaning: a house joined to others in a continuous line
items.meaningCN: 排屋；连成一排的联立房屋
items.example: The street is lined with red brick row houses.
items.exampleCN: 这条街两侧是红砖排屋。

items.meaning: a small boat moved with oars
items.example: We rented a rowing boat by the lake.
items.exampleCN: 我们在湖边租了一条划艇。

items.meaning: one after another without a break
items.example: She wore the same coat five days in a row.
items.exampleCN: 她连续五天穿同一件外套。

items.meaning: to make a loud noise in protest
items.meaningCN: 大吵大闹；起哄（此处 row 为另一同形词，读 /raʊ/，指吵嚷）
items.example: The neighbours kicked up a row about the noise.
items.exampleCN: 邻居们为噪音大吵大闹。

items.meaning: a person who rows a boat
items.example: Each rower pulls hard on the oars.

items.meaning: the sport of moving boats with oars
items.example: Rowing is popular on this river.
items.exampleCN: 划船运动在这条河上很流行。

items.meaning: the part of a prison for prisoners waiting execution
items.meaningCN: 死囚区；关押待决死刑犯的监区
items.example: The novel is set on death row.
items.exampleCN: 这部小说以死囚区为背景。

items.meaning: a line of chairs side by side
items.example: A whole row of seats was empty.

items.meaning: a poor area of a city where homeless people live
items.meaningCN: 贫民街；流浪者聚集的城市街区
items.example: He ended up living on skid row.
items.exampleCN: 他最后沦落到贫民街栖身。

definition_en: waste material that is thrown away; things of poor quality; foolish talk or ideas
core_image: 一堆被丢弃、不再有用的东西
scene: 请把厨房里的垃圾拿出去。Please take the rubbish out of the kitchen.
sceneCN: 这里 rubbish 是「垃圾」（第 1 个义项）；句意：请把厨房里的垃圾拿出去。

senses.title: Waste material
senses.definition: waste material that is thrown away
senses.definitionCN: 被丢弃的废弃材料
senses.example: The bin was full of rubbish.
senses.exampleCN: 垃圾桶里装满了垃圾。
senses.why: The core sense is useless waste.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是无用的废弃物。

senses.title: Poor quality things
senses.definition: things that are of very poor quality
senses.definitionCN: 质量极差的东西
senses.example: The film was pure rubbish.
senses.exampleCN: 那部电影简直一无是处。
senses.why: Waste material becomes a judgment on things.
senses.whyCN: 废弃物变成了对事物的评价。

senses.title: Foolish talk
senses.definition: foolish talk or ideas
senses.definitionCN: 愚蠢的话或想法
senses.example: Don't talk rubbish about her.
senses.exampleCN: 别乱说她的是非。
senses.why: Worthless things become worthless words.
senses.whyCN: 没有价值的东西变成没有价值的话。

intro.en: Rubbish comes from Middle English robous, rubble or waste.
intro.cn: rubbish 源自中古英语 robous，意为碎石、废料。

items.en: Robous names broken stone and waste.
items.cn: robous 指碎石与废料。

items.en: Related forms describe rubble from buildings.
items.cn: 相关词形描述建筑物产生的碎石。

items.en: Rubbish broadens to household waste.
items.cn: rubbish 扩大到家庭垃圾。

items.en: Rubbish also means worthless things.
items.cn: rubbish 也指毫无价值的东西。

items.en: Talk rubbish is a common phrase.
items.cn: talk rubbish 成为常用说法。

note.en: Rubbish is waste; rubble is broken stone.
note.cn: rubbish 是垃圾，rubble 则是碎砖石。

entries.definition: to move a hand over a surface
a soft material from tree sap

normalIntro.en: Rubbish is what is thrown out or has no worth.
normalIntro.cn: rubbish 是被扔掉或没有价值的东西。

normal.en: The street was covered in rubbish after the fair.
normal.cn: 集市过后街上到处是垃圾。

normal.en: That argument is complete rubbish.
normal.cn: 那个论点完全站不住脚。

normal.en: They collect rubbish every Tuesday morning.
normal.cn: 他们每周二早上收垃圾。

normal.en: He threw the old magazines into the rubbish.
normal.cn: 他把旧杂志扔进了垃圾里。

normal.en: Do not believe the rubbish in that message.
normal.cn: 别相信那条消息里的胡话。

abstract.en: Picture a bin overflowing at the curb.
abstract.cn: 想象路边一个满溢的垃圾桶。

abstract.en: Imagine torn paper blowing across a yard.
abstract.cn: 想象碎纸在院子里被风吹动。

abstract.en: Think of words that fall apart as you hear them.
abstract.cn: 想象一些话一听就站不住脚。

examples.en: The council collects household rubbish on Mondays.
examples.cn: 市政部门每周一收集生活垃圾。

examples.en: The film was dismissed as rubbish by critics.
examples.cn: 评论家斥那部电影为垃圾。

examples.en: He talks rubbish when he is nervous.
examples.cn: 他一紧张就胡说八道。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rubbish」读起来像「垃圾堆里拉比什」，可以联想一袋被人丢弃的垃圾。

root: 中古英语 robous（碎石、废料）进入英语后扩展为「垃圾、废物、废话」。

sensesIntro.en: Rubbish means waste material, things of poor quality, or foolish talk.
sensesIntro.cn: rubbish 意为废弃物、劣质东西，或废话。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heap of things thrown away.
core.cn: 核心意象：一堆被丢弃的东西。

branches.en: The base sense is physical waste.
branches.cn: 基础义是实体的废弃物。

branches.en: Waste becomes a judgment of quality.
branches.cn: 废弃物变成对质量的判断。

branches.en: Worthless things become worthless words.
branches.cn: 无价值之物变成无价值之言。

branches.en: Physical and figurative waste share worthlessness.
branches.cn: 实体垃圾与比喻性垃圾都指没有价值。

branches.en: Bad products and bad talk are both dismissed.
branches.cn: 劣质产品与胡言乱语都会被否定。

intro.en: Rubbish is an old English word without a Latin root.
intro.cn: rubbish 是古老的英语词，没有拉丁词根。

latinIntro.en: Rubbish has no Latin root; it comes from Middle English.
latinIntro.cn: rubbish 没有拉丁词根，它来自中古英语。

items.example: Robous is the earliest recorded form.
items.exampleCN: robous 是最早有记载的形式。

items.example: Rubbish keeps the sense of waste.

items.exampleCN: rubbishy 形容廉价劣质的东西。

items.example: Bin forms the compound rubbish bin.
items.exampleCN: bin 构成复合词 rubbish bin。

items.example: Dump forms the compound rubbish dump.
items.exampleCN: dump 构成复合词 rubbish dump。

definition_en: not polite; offensive or insulting; roughly made or simple
core_image: 未经打磨的粗糙表面，欠缺应有的礼数
scene: 对服务员大喊大叫是很无礼的。Shouting at the waiter is very rude.
sceneCN: 这里 rude 是「无礼的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：对服务员大喊大叫是很无礼的。

senses.title: Not polite
senses.definition: not polite in behavior or speech
senses.definitionCN: 言行上不礼貌的
senses.example: It is rude to interrupt.
senses.exampleCN: 打断别人说话是不礼貌的。
senses.why: The core sense is a lack of polish.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是欠缺应有的修养。

senses.title: Offensive
senses.definition: offensive or insulting in an obvious way
senses.definitionCN: 明显冒犯或侮辱人的
senses.example: He made a rude gesture.
senses.exampleCN: 他做了个粗鲁的手势。
senses.why: Impoliteness hardens into open offence.
senses.whyCN: 不礼貌固化为公开冒犯。

senses.title: Roughly made
senses.definition: roughly made or simple in a primitive way
senses.definitionCN: 制作粗糙或原始简朴的
senses.example: They sheltered in a rude wooden hut.
senses.exampleCN: 他们躲在一间简陋的木屋里。
senses.why: The old sense is raw and unformed.
senses.whyCN: 旧义是未经加工、粗糙的。

intro.en: Rude comes from Latin rudis, raw and unformed.
intro.cn: rude 源自拉丁语 rudis，意为原始、未加工的。

items.en: Rudis means raw or rough.
items.cn: rudis 意为生的、粗糙的。

items.en: Rude keeps the sense of roughness.
items.cn: rude 保留粗糙的含义。

items.en: Rude describes rough work or manners.
items.cn: rude 形容粗糙的作品或举止。

items.en: Rude shifts toward social impoliteness.
items.cn: rude 转向指社交上的不礼貌。

items.en: Rude mainly means impolite today.
items.cn: 如今 rude 主要表示不礼貌。

note.en: Rude is impolite; crude is rough or unrefined.
note.cn: rude 是不礼貌，crude 则是粗制或粗俗。

entries.definition: a statement of what is allowed

normalIntro.en: Rude is unpolished, either in manners or in form.
normalIntro.cn: rude 是未经打磨，既指礼数也指做工。

normal.en: It is rude to point at people.
normal.cn: 用手指人是不礼貌的。

normal.en: She was rude to the driver for no reason.
normal.cn: 她无缘无故对司机无礼。

normal.en: The visitors made rude comments about the food.
normal.cn: 客人们对食物说了些粗鲁的话。

normal.en: They built a rude shelter from branches.
normal.cn: 他们用树枝搭了个简陋的棚子。

normal.en: His rude awakening came when the bill arrived.
normal.cn: 账单寄来时他才猛然醒悟。

abstract.en: Picture a rough stone never polished smooth.
abstract.cn: 想象一块从未打磨光滑的石头。

abstract.en: Imagine a door slammed in someone's face.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门当着人的面被摔上。

abstract.en: Think of a hut made from loose branches.
abstract.cn: 想象一间用松散树枝搭成的小屋。

examples.en: The clerk was rude to every customer.
examples.cn: 那名店员对每位顾客都很无礼。

examples.en: He apologized for his rude remarks.
examples.cn: 他为自己的无礼言论道歉。

examples.en: They slept in a rude hut near the river.
examples.cn: 他们睡在河边一间简陋的木屋里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rude」读音像「鲁的」：言行鲁莽无礼，就是「粗鲁的」。

root: 拉丁语 rudis（生的、未加工的）经古法语进入英语，核心义「未经打磨」，由物及人引申为「无礼」。

sensesIntro.en: Rude means impolite, openly offensive, or roughly and simply made.
sensesIntro.cn: rude 意为不礼貌的、公然冒犯的，或制作粗糙简朴的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rough surface with no polish.
core.cn: 核心意象：没有打磨过的粗糙表面。

branches.en: The base sense is a lack of good manners.
branches.cn: 基础义是缺乏礼貌。

branches.en: Impoliteness becomes open offence.
branches.cn: 不礼貌变成公然冒犯。

branches.en: The old sense of roughness survives in objects.
branches.cn: 「粗糙」的旧义仍保留在物品上。

branches.en: Both concern behavior that harms others.
branches.cn: 两者都涉及伤害他人的行为。

branches.en: Unpolished manners and unpolished wood pair up.
branches.cn: 未修饰的举止与未打磨的木头相互对应。

intro.en: Rude comes from Latin rudis without a prefix.
intro.cn: rude 来自拉丁语 rudis，不带前缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin rudis is the direct source of rude.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rudis 是 rude 的直接来源。

items.example: Rudis is the source of rude.
items.exampleCN: rudis 是 rude 的来源。

items.example: Rude keeps the sense of roughness.

definition_en: an unverified story spread from person to person; general talk about something; to spread something as gossip
core_image: 一句未经证实的话在人群里悄悄传开
scene: 关于公司裁员的谣言迅速传开。The rumour about job cuts spread quickly.
sceneCN: 这里 rumour 是「谣言、传闻」（第 1 个义项）；句意：关于公司裁员的谣言迅速传开。

senses.title: Unverified story
senses.definition: an unverified story spread from person to person
senses.definitionCN: 在人与人之间传播的未经证实的故事
senses.example: There is a rumour that the factory will close.
senses.exampleCN: 有传闻说工厂将要关闭。
senses.why: The core sense is talk without proof.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是没有证据的说法。

senses.title: General talk
senses.definition: general talk about something, often unkind
senses.definitionCN: 关于某事的普遍议论，常带恶意
senses.example: Rumour spread through the village.
senses.exampleCN: 流言在村里传开了。
senses.why: One story becomes a wave of talk.
senses.whyCN: 一个说法变成一片议论。

senses.title: To spread as gossip
senses.definition: to spread something as gossip
senses.definitionCN: 把某事当作流言传播
senses.example: He is rumoured to be leaving.
senses.exampleCN: 据传他要离开。
senses.why: The noun becomes the act of spreading talk.
senses.whyCN: 名词变成传播说法的动作。

intro.en: Rumour comes from Latin rumor, noise or common talk.
intro.cn: rumour 源自拉丁语 rumor，意为喧哗或众人议论。

items.en: Rumor means noise or common talk.
items.cn: rumor 意为喧哗或众人议论。

items.en: Rumour keeps the sense of talk.
items.cn: rumour 保留议论之义。

items.en: Rumour names unconfirmed news.
items.cn: rumour 指未经证实的消息。

items.en: The verb rumour appears in formal use.
items.cn: 动词 rumour 出现在正式用法中。

items.en: Rumour has it is a fixed phrase.
items.cn: rumour has it 成为固定说法。

note.en: A rumour is unproven talk; a report is a formal account.
note.cn: rumour 是未经证实的传言，report 则是正式报道。

entries.definition: a formal account of an event

normalIntro.en: A rumour is talk that travels before the facts.
normalIntro.cn: rumour 是跑在事实前面的说法。

normal.en: The rumour spread faster than the news.
normal.cn: 谣言的传播比新闻还快。

normal.en: She denied the rumour at once.
normal.cn: 她立刻否认了传闻。

normal.en: Rumour has it that the shop is closing.
normal.cn: 据传这家店要关门了。

normal.en: He is rumoured to have left the country.
normal.cn: 据传他已离开这个国家。

normal.en: Do not repeat a rumour you cannot prove.
normal.cn: 不要传播你无法证实的谣言。

abstract.en: Picture a whisper passing down a row of seats.
abstract.cn: 想象一句耳语沿着一排座位传下去。

abstract.en: Imagine a paper note folded and passed hand to hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸条被一只手传到另一只手。

abstract.en: Think of smoke that grows as it drifts.
abstract.cn: 想象烟越飘越浓。

examples.en: A rumour about the merger reached the press.
examples.cn: 关于合并的传闻传到了媒体那里。

examples.en: The rumour proved to be completely false.
examples.cn: 这个传闻被证明完全不实。

examples.en: It is rumoured that the coach will resign.
examples.cn: 据传教练将要辞职。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rumour」读音像「入耳」：一句话进到你耳朵里，却未必是真的，就是「谣言」。

root: 拉丁语 rumor（喧哗、众人议论）经古法语进入英语，核心义「没有确证却四处传播的说法」。

sensesIntro.en: Rumour means an unverified story, general talk, or to spread something as gossip.
sensesIntro.cn: rumour 意为未经证实的传闻、普遍议论，或把它当作流言传播。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whisper moving from ear to ear.
core.cn: 核心意象：一句耳语从一只耳朵传到另一只。

branches.en: The base sense is an unproven story.
branches.cn: 基础义是未经证实的故事。

branches.en: One story becomes a wave of talk.
branches.cn: 一个说法变成一片议论。

branches.en: The noun becomes the act of spreading talk.
branches.cn: 名词变成传播说法的动作。

branches.en: A single rumour feeds wider gossip.
branches.cn: 单个谣言喂养更广的流言。

branches.en: The story and spreading it are linked.
branches.cn: 传闻与传播它的动作相互关联。

intro.en: Rumour is a borrowing from Latin and Old French.
intro.cn: rumour 是从拉丁语和古法语借入的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin rumor, noise or talk, is the direct source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rumor（喧哗、议论）是直接来源。

items.exampleCN: rumoured 描述未经证实的消息。
spread 常与 rumour 搭配。

items.meaning: to say it is not true
items.exampleCN: deny 常与 rumour 搭配。

definition_en: relating to the countryside; typical of country life; based on farming and land
core_image: 一片开阔的田野、村庄和乡间小路
scene: 他们从城市搬到了乡下。They moved from the city to a rural area.
sceneCN: 这里 rural 是「乡下的、农村的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他们从城市搬到了乡下。

senses.title: Of the countryside
senses.definition: relating to the countryside rather than towns
senses.definitionCN: 与乡村而非城镇有关的
senses.example: The clinic serves a large rural area.
senses.exampleCN: 这家诊所为大片农村地区服务。
senses.why: The core sense is open country.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是开阔的乡野。

senses.title: Country life
senses.definition: typical of life in the countryside
senses.definitionCN: 具有乡村生活特征的
senses.example: The village still has a rural charm.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村庄仍保留着田园魅力。
senses.why: Place becomes a style of life.
senses.whyCN: 地点变成一种生活方式。

senses.title: Farming based
senses.definition: based on farming and land work
senses.definitionCN: 以耕作和土地劳动为基础的
senses.example: Rural employment depends on farming.
senses.exampleCN: 农村就业依赖农业。
senses.why: Country life is tied to working the land.
senses.whyCN: 乡村生活与土地劳作紧密相连。

intro.en: Rural comes from Latin ruralis, from rus, open country.
intro.cn: rural 源自拉丁语 ruralis，来自 rus（开阔的乡野）。

items.en: Rus means open land or countryside.
items.cn: rus 意为开阔的土地或乡野。

items.en: Ruralis means of the countryside.
items.cn: ruralis 意为乡野的。

items.en: Rural keeps the country sense.
items.cn: rural 保留乡村之义。

items.en: Rural contrasts with urban.
items.cn: rural 与 urban 相对。

items.en: Rural development is a common phrase.
items.cn: rural development 成为常用搭配。

note.en: Rural means country; royal means kingly.
note.cn: rural 是乡村的，royal 则是王室的。

entries.definition: relating to a king or queen
using the basic meaning of words

normalIntro.en: Rural describes fields, villages, and country life.
normalIntro.cn: rural 描述田野、村庄与乡村生活。

normal.en: The rural road was quiet at dusk.
normal.cn: 傍晚的乡间小路很安静。

normal.en: Many young people leave rural towns for work.
normal.cn: 许多年轻人离开乡村去谋生。

normal.en: A rural school may have only a few pupils.
normal.cn: 乡村学校可能只有几个学生。

normal.en: The family enjoys a rural way of life.
normal.cn: 这家人喜欢乡村生活方式。

normal.en: Rural areas often lack fast internet.
normal.cn: 农村地区常常缺乏高速网络。

abstract.en: Picture a wide field under a low sky.
abstract.cn: 想象低垂天空下的一片广阔田野。

abstract.en: Imagine a lane bordered by hedges.
abstract.cn: 想象一条两旁是树篱的小路。

abstract.en: Think of a village bell heard far away.
abstract.cn: 想象远处传来的村庄钟声。

examples.en: The doctor travels between several rural villages.
examples.cn: 这位医生往返于几个乡村之间。

examples.en: Rural life can feel slow and peaceful.
examples.cn: 乡村生活可能显得缓慢而宁静。

examples.en: The government funds rural schools.
examples.cn: 政府为农村学校提供资金。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rural」里有 rur，联想「入乡」：走进乡野，就是「乡村的、田园的」。

root: 拉丁语 rus（开阔乡野）的形容词 ruralis 进入英语，核心义「属于乡村与土地的」。

sensesIntro.en: Rural means relating to the countryside, typical of country life, or based on farming.
sensesIntro.cn: rural 意为与乡村有关的、具有乡村生活特征的，或以农业为基础的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: open fields and small villages.
core.cn: 核心意象：开阔田野与小村庄。

branches.en: The base sense is belonging to the country.
branches.cn: 基础义是属于乡村。

branches.en: Place becomes a way of living.
branches.cn: 地点变成一种生活方式。

branches.en: Country life is tied to farming.
branches.cn: 乡村生活与农业相连。

branches.en: Landscape and daily life go together.
branches.cn: 景观与日常生活相伴。

branches.en: Country style and farm work overlap.
branches.cn: 乡村风格与农活相互重叠。

intro.en: Rural comes from Latin rus with the adjective ending -alis.
intro.cn: rural 来自拉丁语 rus，并带形容词词尾 -alis。

latinIntro.en: Latin rus (country) and ruralis are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rus（乡村）与 ruralis 是来源词形。

items.example: Rus is the source of rural.
items.exampleCN: rus 是 rural 的来源。

definition_en: a reddish coating that forms on iron; a plant disease; to become covered with rust
core_image: 铁表面慢慢爬满一层红褐色粉末
scene: 雨水让旧铁门生满了锈。Rain left the old iron gate covered in rust.
sceneCN: 这里 rust 是「铁锈」（第 1 个义项）；句意：雨水让旧铁门生满了锈。

senses.title: Iron coating
senses.definition: a reddish coating that forms on iron
senses.definitionCN: 铁表面形成的红褐色覆盖层
senses.example: The gate was covered in rust.
senses.exampleCN: 大门上布满了锈。
senses.why: The core sense is corroded iron.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是受腐蚀的铁面。

senses.title: Plant disease
senses.definition: a disease that leaves reddish spots on plants
senses.definitionCN: 在植物上留下红色斑点的病害
senses.example: Rust damaged the wheat crop.
senses.exampleCN: 锈病损害了小麦收成。
senses.why: The colour and spread are applied to plants.
senses.whyCN: 颜色与蔓延的特征被用于植物。

senses.title: To corrode
senses.definition: to become covered with rust
senses.definitionCN: 表面覆盖上锈
senses.example: The old car has rusted away.
senses.exampleCN: 那辆旧车已经锈蚀掉了。
senses.why: The noun becomes the process.
senses.whyCN: 名词变成生锈的过程。

intro.en: Rust comes from Old English rust, linked to the colour red.
intro.cn: rust 源自古英语 rust，与红色有关。

items.en: Rust names the red coat on iron.
items.cn: rust 指铁上的红色覆盖层。

items.en: Related words link rust with redness.
items.cn: 相关词把 rust 与红色联系起来。

items.en: Rust also names a plant disease.
items.cn: rust 也指一种植物病害。

items.en: Rust becomes a verb for corroding.
items.cn: rust 成为表示生锈的动词。

items.en: Rustproof is a common technical word.
items.cn: rustproof 成为常见技术词。

note.en: Rust is iron corrosion; dust is dry powder.
note.cn: rust 是铁锈，dust 则是灰尘。

normalIntro.en: Rust is what iron becomes when air and water win.
normalIntro.cn: rust 是空气和水战胜铁之后的产物。

normal.en: A patch of rust spread across the roof.
normal.cn: 一块锈斑在屋顶上蔓延。

normal.en: The chain rusted solid in the rain.
normal.cn: 铁链在雨中生锈卡死了。

normal.en: They painted the fence to stop rust.
normal.cn: 他们给栅栏刷漆防锈。

normal.en: Rust ruined the old tools in the shed.
normal.cn: 锈毁了棚子里的旧工具。

normal.en: This metal is treated to resist rust.
normal.cn: 这种金属经过处理以抗锈。

abstract.en: Picture red flakes spreading over grey iron.
abstract.cn: 想象红色薄片在灰铁上蔓延。

abstract.en: Imagine a lock slowly refusing to turn.
abstract.cn: 想象一把锁慢慢转不动了。

abstract.en: Think of time quietly eating metal.
abstract.cn: 想象时间悄悄侵蚀金属。

examples.en: Salt air makes the metal rust faster.
examples.cn: 含盐的空气使金属生锈更快。

examples.en: The old pipes were badly rusted.
examples.cn: 旧管道锈得很厉害。

examples.en: Rust had eaten through the thin sheet.
examples.cn: 锈已经蚀穿了薄板。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rust」读音短而硬，像铁表面粗糙的红锈；可联想「铁锈让东西生锈」。

root: 古英语 rust（铁上的红色覆盖层）与日耳曼语中表示红色的词同源，核心义「铁被侵蚀后的红褐色产物」。

sensesIntro.en: Rust means the red coating on iron, a plant disease, or to become corroded.
sensesIntro.cn: rust 意为铁锈、一种植物锈病，或生锈腐蚀。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: red flakes eating into iron.
core.cn: 核心意象：红色薄片侵蚀铁面。

branches.en: The base sense is the coating on iron.
branches.cn: 基础义是铁上的锈层。

branches.en: The colour and spread apply to plants.
branches.cn: 颜色与蔓延特征用于植物。

branches.en: The noun becomes the corroding process.
branches.cn: 名词变成腐蚀过程。

branches.en: The coating is the result of the process.
branches.cn: 锈层是腐蚀过程的结果。

branches.en: Metal rust and plant rust share red spots.
branches.cn: 金属锈与植物锈病都有红色斑点。

intro.en: Rust is an Old English word with many compounds.
intro.cn: rust 是古英语词，复合形式很多。

latinIntro.en: Rust has no Latin root; it is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: rust 没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语族。

items.exampleCN: rusty 描述受腐蚀的金属。
rustproof 描述经过处理的金属。

definition_en: a large bag; an informal word for dismissal from a job; to dismiss someone; to plunder a town
core_image: 一只鼓鼓的大麻袋，或被人一把清空
scene: 他扛着一袋土豆走进厨房。He carried a sack of potatoes into the kitchen.
sceneCN: 这里 sack 是「麻袋、大袋」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他扛着一袋土豆走进厨房。

senses.title: Large bag
senses.definition: a large bag made of strong material
senses.definitionCN: 用结实材料制成的大袋子
senses.example: The farmer filled a sack with grain.
senses.exampleCN: 农夫把一袋谷物装满。
senses.why: The core object is a big bag.
senses.whyCN: 核心物件是大袋子。

senses.title: Dismissal
senses.definition: an informal word for being dismissed from a job
senses.definitionCN: 被解雇的非正式说法
senses.example: She got the sack for being late.
senses.exampleCN: 她因迟到被解雇了。
senses.why: Being sent away with your bag becomes dismissal.
senses.whyCN: 带着袋子被赶走变成了解雇。

senses.title: To dismiss
senses.definition: to dismiss someone from a job
senses.definitionCN: 把某人从工作中解雇
senses.example: They sacked the manager.
senses.exampleCN: 他们解雇了经理。
senses.why: The noun becomes the action.
senses.whyCN: 名词变成动作。

senses.title: To plunder
senses.definition: to steal everything from a captured town
senses.definitionCN: 从被攻占的城镇抢走一切
senses.example: The soldiers sacked the city.
senses.exampleCN: 士兵们洗劫了这座城市。
senses.why: Emptying a place is like emptying a sack.
senses.whyCN: 清空一座城就像倒空一只袋子。

intro.en: Sack has two origins: a Latin bag and a French word for plunder.
intro.cn: sack 有两个来源：拉丁语的袋子和法语中表示劫掠的词。

items.en: Saccus means a bag.
items.cn: saccus 意为袋子。

items.en: Sakkos names a coarse bag.
items.cn: sakkos 指粗布袋。

items.en: Sac means plunder or pillage.
items.cn: sac 意为劫掠。

items.en: Sak covers both bag and plunder.
items.cn: sak 兼指袋子与劫掠。

items.en: The sack comes to mean dismissal.
items.cn: the sack 引申为解雇。

note.en: A sack is a bag; to sock is to hit.
note.cn: sack 是袋子，sock 作动词则是猛击。

entries.definition: to remove someone from a job

normalIntro.en: A sack holds goods, and to sack is to empty a place.
normalIntro.cn: sack 能装东西，而 to sack 是把一个地方清空。

normal.en: He bought a sack of rice at the market.
normal.cn: 他在市场上买了一袋米。

normal.en: The worker was given the sack without notice.
normal.cn: 那名工人没被通知就被解雇了。

normal.en: The club sacked its coach after the loss.
normal.cn: 输球后俱乐部解雇了教练。

normal.en: The invaders sacked the town and burned it.
normal.cn: 入侵者洗劫并烧毁了小镇。

normal.en: She carried the sack on her shoulder.
normal.cn: 她把袋子扛在肩上。

abstract.en: Picture a heavy bag tied at the top.
abstract.cn: 想象一只扎紧口子的沉重袋子。

abstract.en: Imagine a desk cleared in one sweep.
abstract.cn: 想象桌子一下被清空。

abstract.en: Think of a town stripped bare.
abstract.cn: 想象一座城被抢得空空如也。

examples.en: They loaded the sacks onto the truck.
examples.cn: 他们把麻袋装上卡车。

examples.en: The coach was sacked after a poor season.
examples.cn: 赛季表现不佳后教练被解雇。

examples.en: The army sacked the old capital.
examples.cn: 军队洗劫了旧都。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「sack」读音像「塞克」：把东西往袋子里塞，就是「麻袋」；把人塞出门，就是「解雇」。

root: 袋子义来自拉丁语 saccus（袋），劫掠义来自古法语 sac，两条词源进入英语后合成今天的 sack。

sensesIntro.en: Sack means a large bag, dismissal, to dismiss, or to plunder a place.
sensesIntro.cn: sack 意为大袋、解雇、解雇某人，或洗劫某地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a big bag, or a place emptied out.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只大袋子，或被清空的地方。

branches.en: The base sense is a large bag.
branches.cn: 基础义是大袋子。

branches.en: Being sent off with your bag becomes dismissal.
branches.cn: 带着袋子被赶走变成解雇。

branches.en: The noun becomes the act of dismissing.
branches.cn: 名词变成解雇的动作。

branches.en: Emptying a place becomes plunder.
branches.cn: 清空一个地方变成劫掠。

branches.en: Dismissal as a noun and verb pair up.
branches.cn: 解雇的名词与动词相互对应。

intro.en: Sack comes from two sources and builds several compounds.
intro.cn: sack 有两个来源，并构成多个复合词。

latinIntro.en: The bag sense goes back to Latin saccus.
latinIntro.cn: 「袋子」义可追溯到拉丁语 saccus。

definition_en: to give up something valuable; to offer something to a god; the thing given up or offered
core_image: 把珍贵的东西郑重地放上祭台
scene: 父母为孩子牺牲了很多个人时间。The parents sacrificed a lot of personal time for their children.
sceneCN: 这里 sacrifice 是「牺牲、放弃」（第 1 个义项）；句意：父母为孩子牺牲了很多个人时间。

senses.title: Give up something
senses.definition: to give up something valuable for a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为了某个目的放弃有价值的东西
senses.example: She sacrificed her career for the family.
senses.exampleCN: 她为了家庭放弃了自己的事业。
senses.why: The core sense is giving up something valued.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是放弃珍视之物。

senses.title: Offer to a god
senses.definition: to offer something to a god in a ceremony
senses.definitionCN: 在仪式中把某物献给神
senses.example: They sacrificed a goat at the temple.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在神庙献祭了一只山羊。
senses.why: Giving up becomes a sacred offering.
senses.whyCN: 放弃变成神圣的奉献。

senses.title: The cost borne
senses.definition: the thing given up for a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为某个目的而放弃的东西
senses.example: The plan required great sacrifice.
senses.exampleCN: 这个计划需要巨大牺牲。
senses.why: The act becomes the cost itself.
senses.whyCN: 动作变成所承受的代价。

intro.en: Sacrifice comes from Latin sacrificium, a sacred offering.
intro.cn: sacrifice 源自拉丁语 sacrificium，意为神圣的供奉。

items.en: Sacer means holy or sacred.
items.cn: sacer 意为神圣的。

items.en: Facere means to make or do.
items.cn: facere 意为制作、做。

items.en: Sacrificium joins holy and making.
items.cn: sacrificium 把「神圣」与「做」结合。

items.en: Sacrifice keeps the offering sense.
items.cn: sacrifice 保留供奉之义。

items.en: Sacrifice covers both rite and cost.
items.cn: sacrifice 兼指仪式与代价。

items.en: Personal sacrifice becomes common usage.
items.cn: personal sacrifice 成为常见说法。

note.en: Sacrifice is giving up; to suffice is to be enough.
note.cn: sacrifice 是放弃，suffice 则是足够。

normalIntro.en: Sacrifice is giving up something precious for something more important.
normalIntro.cn: sacrifice 是为更重要的东西放弃珍贵之物。

normal.en: Many parents sacrifice their own comfort.
normal.cn: 许多父母牺牲自己的舒适。

normal.en: The villagers sacrificed food at the harvest.
normal.cn: 村民在收获时献上食物。

normal.en: Victory came at a heavy sacrifice.
normal.cn: 胜利以沉重牺牲为代价。

normal.en: He sacrificed sleep to finish the work.
normal.cn: 他为完成工作牺牲了睡眠。

normal.en: The team made great sacrifices for the project.
normal.cn: 团队为这个项目作出了巨大牺牲。

abstract.en: Picture a prized object laid on a stone altar.
abstract.cn: 想象一件珍贵之物被放在石祭台上。

abstract.en: Imagine letting go of something you love.
abstract.cn: 想象放开你喜爱的东西。

abstract.en: Think of a candle burning itself to give light.
abstract.cn: 想象蜡烛燃烧自己照亮别人。

examples.en: She sacrificed her free time to help the club.
examples.cn: 她牺牲空闲时间来帮助俱乐部。

examples.en: The ancient rite involved a sacrifice.
examples.cn: 这种古老仪式包含献祭。

examples.en: Success here demands real sacrifice.
examples.cn: 在这里取得成功需要真正的牺牲。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「sacrifice」里有 sacri（神圣）：把珍贵的东西献给更重要的目标，就是「牺牲、献祭」。

root: 拉丁语 sacrificium 由 sacer（神圣的）与 facere（做）构成，核心义「做神圣之事、献上供物」。

sensesIntro.en: Sacrifice means to give something up, to offer it to a god, or the cost that is borne.
sensesIntro.cn: sacrifice 意为放弃某物、向神献祭，或所承受的代价。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something precious placed on an altar.
core.cn: 核心意象：珍贵之物被放上祭台。

branches.en: The base sense is giving up something valued.
branches.cn: 基础义是放弃珍视之物。

branches.en: Giving up becomes a sacred offering.
branches.cn: 放弃变成神圣供奉。

branches.en: The act becomes the cost borne.
branches.cn: 动作变成承受的代价。

branches.en: What you give up is the cost.
branches.cn: 你所放弃的正是代价。

branches.en: Everyday loss and ritual offering share the act.
branches.cn: 日常损失与仪式供奉共享同一动作。

intro.en: Sacrifice joins Latin sacer (holy) and facere (to make).
intro.cn: sacrifice 由拉丁语 sacer（神圣）与 facere（做）组合。

latinIntro.en: Latin sacer, facere, and sacrificium are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sacer、facere 与 sacrificium 是来源词形。

items.example: Facere means to perform a rite.

definition_en: money paid regularly to an employee, usually every month; income from work
core_image: 每月固定打进账户的一笔工资
scene: 她的月薪足以支付房租。Her monthly salary covers the rent.
sceneCN: 这里 salary 是「月薪、薪水」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她的月薪足以支付房租。

senses.title: Regular pay
senses.definition: money paid regularly to an employee for work
senses.definitionCN: 因工作定期支付给雇员的钱
senses.example: She earns a good salary as a nurse.
senses.exampleCN: 她当护士薪水不错。
senses.why: The core sense is regular payment for work.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是为工作定期支付的报酬。

senses.title: Total yearly pay
senses.definition: the total amount earned in a year
senses.definitionCN: 一年内挣得的总金额
senses.example: The job offers a salary of fifty thousand.
senses.exampleCN: 这份工作提供五万的年薪。
senses.why: Regular pay becomes an annual figure.
senses.whyCN: 定期薪水变成年度总额。

senses.title: Reward for work
senses.definition: the reward a person receives for employment
senses.definitionCN: 个人因受雇而获得的报酬
senses.example: He accepted a lower salary for more free time.
senses.exampleCN: 为了更多空闲时间，他接受了较低的报酬。
senses.why: The payment becomes one part of a job's value.
senses.whyCN: 报酬变成工作价值的一部分。

intro.en: Salary comes from Latin salarium, an allowance connected with salt.
intro.cn: salary 来自拉丁语 salarium，一种与盐有关的津贴。

items.en: Sal means salt.
items.cn: sal 意为盐。

items.en: Salarium means a salt allowance or payment.
items.cn: salarium 意为盐钱或津贴。

items.en: Roman soldiers received money for salt.
items.cn: 罗马士兵会领取买盐的钱。

items.en: Salarie names regular payment for work.
items.cn: salarie 指为工作支付的定期报酬。

items.en: Salary means fixed monthly or yearly pay.
items.cn: 现代英语中 salary 指固定的月薪或年薪。

note.en: Salary is fixed pay; wage is often hourly pay.
note.cn: salary 是固定薪水，wage 常指按小时计算的工资。

entries.definition: money paid for work, often by the hour
money received from work or investments

normalIntro.en: Salary is the regular money a person receives for a job.
normalIntro.cn: salary 是个人因工作定期收到的钱。

normal.en: He spends half his salary on rent.
normal.cn: 他把一半薪水花在房租上。

normal.en: The company raised salaries this year.
normal.cn: 公司今年提高了薪水。

normal.en: She negotiated a higher salary.
normal.cn: 她谈到了更高的薪水。

normal.en: Salary is paid on the last day of the month.
normal.cn: 薪水在每月最后一天发放。

normal.en: Many teachers earn a modest salary.
normal.cn: 许多教师薪水不高。

abstract.en: Picture a fixed amount arriving every month.
abstract.cn: 想象每个月固定到账的一笔钱。

abstract.en: Imagine a pay slip with one clear number.
abstract.cn: 想象一张写着一个清楚数字的工资单。

abstract.en: Think of salt traded for a soldier's pay.
abstract.cn: 想象用盐来交换士兵的报酬。

examples.en: Her salary is paid monthly.
examples.cn: 她的薪水按月发放。

examples.en: They offered him a higher salary.
examples.cn: 他们给了他更高的薪水。

examples.en: Part of his salary goes to savings.
examples.cn: 他的一部分薪水存入储蓄。

dict_mnemonic.text: salary 与 salt 同源：古罗马给士兵发「盐钱」，后来 salary 就成了薪水。

sensesIntro.en: Salary means regular pay for work, total yearly pay, or the reward of a job.
sensesIntro.cn: salary 意为工作的定期报酬、年度工资总额，或工作回报。

branches.en: The base sense is regular payment for work.

definition_en: the act of selling something; a period when goods are sold at lower prices; the total amount sold

senses.title: The act of selling
senses.definition: the act of exchanging something for money
senses.definitionCN: 用某物换取金钱的行为
senses.example: The sale of the house took months.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋房子的出售花了几个月。
senses.why: The core sense is the exchange of goods for money.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是用货物换取金钱。

senses.title: A discount period
senses.definition: a time when a shop sells goods at lower prices
senses.definitionCN: 商店以较低价格出售商品的时期
senses.example: The winter sale starts next week.
senses.exampleCN: 冬季促销下周开始。
senses.why: The act becomes a special selling event.
senses.whyCN: 销售行为变成特殊的销售活动。

senses.title: Amount sold
senses.definition: the total number or value of goods sold
senses.definitionCN: 售出商品的总数量或总价值
senses.example: Sales rose sharply in December.
senses.exampleCN: 十二月的销售额大幅上升。
senses.why: The act becomes a measurable total.

normal.en: Sales increased after the new ad.
